expected.description: Only a small set of support roles can impersonate, ideally with customer consent or a linked ticket

Impersonation sessions are short lived, clearly marked, and separate from the agent's own session
Being on the VPN is not authorization; the admin tool needs its own strong auth and MFA
Agents see customer personal data, so access needs a business reason and minimization
